# Maintained browser transport compatibility package

`acyclic-tonic-web-wasm-client` 0.2.0 packages maintained `tonic-web-wasm-client` 0.9.2 under an explicit compatibility identity. Consumers use the ordinary direct dependency alias `tonic-web-wasm-client = { package = "acyclic-tonic-web-wasm-client", version = "=0.2.0" }`; no workspace patch or platform-selection feature is required.

The upstream archive SHA256 is `435bc48a5921927390c263ebf21c32f7e2aabbe04f3d2de0d75bddb50608c566`, VCS `146b710ee1b8acf66b3d415e10bef170e461dcc0`. Applied source patch SHA256 `9ad197f3b4505d61793d56a0f32d3642acb2fc318d32c04f6c291e9b45fa6614` reuses maintained upstream changes 98 (base64), 112 (split trailers), 116 (repeated request metadata), 122 (timer conversion), plus bounded pre-copy response accumulation, consumed-offset checks and maintained httparse/header insertion. Apache2.0/MIT licenses are retained byte-for-byte; the package README documents the owned identity and target-selected surface. The original upstream README remains in the retained archive. Root source receipts retain exact baseline/candidate inventory and primary upstream commits.

Version0.2.0 follows the existing publisher requirement that every local release graph owner equal the common SDK release version; the upstream provenance remains0.9.2. Original upstream generated Cargo lock/VCS/normalized manifest metadata are archived as provenance inputs rather than copied as this package's own producer identities. Package normalization must retain the explicit acyclic package/version; standalone archived native tests and ordinary wasm consumers qualify that dependency closure before release.
